audit.why: 48.25% over 659 games is the only losing matchup in this slice, and the existing HARD framing at 8.5/10 matches it. Berserker Rage scales his attack speed and lifesteal off missing health, which is precisely the fight a Granite Shield buffer is worst at: the longer the brawl the better his numbers get.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.win reads Skill, Olaf, Olaf, Skill, Skill, Olaf, Olaf — level 1 is a coinflip and level 6 belongs to nobody, while the page's own text says 'Olaf owns the opener' and calls level 6 'your moment'.
audit.why: The packet levelChart is Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Skill, Malphite, Skill, Olaf, which matches the prose: he owns the whole opener, 4-5 stabilizes, 6 is Malphite's single window, first item is close, and late is his again. Recorded here because one-word cells cannot survive the length band.
audit.corrected: win and phases sides should read: Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Skill, Malphite, Skill, Olaf.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.mid, spikes[1].text, wants.you[0] and whys[4] all say Unstoppable Force interrupts or answers his Ragnarok all-in — for example 'if he flips R on to go CC-immune and dives you, your R knock-up interrupts the commit'.
audit.why: Ragnarok makes Olaf immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking. A knock-up is a disable. So the file tells the player that his single 130-second ultimate is the answer to the one ability it cannot touch — and the full layer already says the opposite in dontsFull ('R into his Ragnarok (immune)'), so the two layers were contradicting each other on the same page. The correct rule is a timing rule: the knock-up has to land before he presses R, or after the 100s at rank 1 runs out.
audit.corrected: Ragnarok is immunity to disables — land Unstoppable Force before he presses it. Once it is on, your knock-up does nothing.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3].text, content.late and whys[6] attribute the true damage to Ragnarok — 'Ragnarok's true damage ignores your armor and Granite Shield'. The full-layer tldr compounds it with 'His %HP true'.
audit.why: Olaf's true damage is Reckless Swing (E), 11/10/9/8/7, and Riot's description gives it as flat true damage he also pays health for — not percent health, and not part of his ultimate. Ragnarok's own contribution is passive armour and magic resist plus the disable immunity. Two different abilities were fused into one wrong sentence, and the fix matters because the counterplay differs: you can space out of a 325-range Reckless Swing, you cannot space out of a stat aura.
audit.corrected: Reckless Swing (E) is the true damage, 11/10/9/8/7 at 325 range. Ragnarok gives resistances and disable immunity.

audit.whatIsWrong: Undertow's armour reduction is never mentioned — the axe is only ever described as a slow.
audit.why: Riot's text: it damages, reduces Armor, and reduces Move Speed. Ground Slam deals magic damage based on Malphite's own armour. So every axe that lands is a direct cut to Malphite's E damage as well as his durability, which makes walking out of the axe's path a damage decision, not just a mobility one. Nothing on the page connected those two abilities.
audit.corrected: Undertow cuts your armour, and your armour is Ground Slam's damage — every axe that lands shrinks your own E.

audit.whatIsWrong: Tough It Out and Berserker Rage are never named, so the page never says why Ground Slam is the right button.
audit.why: Berserker Rage gives attack speed and lifesteal scaling with missing health; Tough It Out (16/15/14/13/12) gives attack speed and a shield. Both of Olaf's damage amplifiers are attack speed, and Ground Slam reduces attack speed on a flat 7s. That is the one mechanical edge Malphite holds in this lane and it was unstated.
audit.corrected: Berserker Rage and Tough It Out are both attack speed — Ground Slam's flat 7s cut is the one thing you own here.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns gave Ragnarok no number, then two placeholder lines.
audit.why: Ragnarok 100/90/80, Undertow flat 9s (resettable on pickup, which the early text already handles correctly), Reckless Swing 11/10/9/8/7, Tough It Out 16/15/14/13/12. The ultimate number is the load-bearing one: it tells the player how long the window is in which a knock-up actually works.
audit.corrected: Ragnarok 100/90/80; Undertow flat 9s; Reckless Swing 11/10/9/8/7; Tough It Out 16/15/14/13/12.

edits.before: Olaf owns the opener and you just have to eat it. His thrown axe slows you and his autos chunk with true damage, so do not try to trade back — at Levels 1-3 you have no trade pattern and Granite Shield barely absorbs a committed Olaf. Use Q's slow and move-speed steal purely to walk away from a landed axe so he cannot pick it up for the reset, and last-hit at max range. Never get caught at low HP near his level-2-3 all-in.
edits.after: Olaf owns the opener and you just have to eat it. Undertow (Q, flat 9s) slows you and cuts your armour, and Reckless Swing (E, 11s at rank 1) is flat true damage that armour cannot touch. Do not trade back at Levels 1-3. Walk away from a landed axe so he cannot pick it up and reset the cooldown, and last-hit at max range. Never sit at low HP near his level 2-3 all-in — Berserker Rage feeds him attack speed as he loses health.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stabilize as W and E come online — your W armor-splash and E attack-speed slow finally let you farm through his axes, but you are still reactive, not winning. Level 6 is your moment: Unstoppable Force is the one tool that beats his Ragnarok all-in — if he flips R on to go CC-immune and dives you, your R knock-up interrupts the commit or sets up your jungler. Hold it as your answer to his all-in, or use it to roam rather than burning it to trade.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stabilize as W and E come online — Thunderclap's splash and Ground Slam's attack-speed cut answer both Berserker Rage and Tough It Out (W, 16s at rank 1), but you are reactive, not winning. Level 6 needs care: Ragnarok makes him immune to disables, so Unstoppable Force does NOT interrupt an active R. Land the knock-up before he presses it, or wait out the 100s at rank 1. Use it to roam rather than burning it on a trade.

edits.before: First item you stack armor — Frozen Heart or Sunfire plus your E slow lets you out-trade most AD, but Olaf is the exception you can never fully solve: Ragnarok's true damage ignores your armor stacking AND your Granite Shield, so a fed Olaf still wins the straight 1v1 even when you are tanky. Do not split-duel him. Your value is the frontline — flank his carries with R in teamfights and let his lifesteal duel sustain mean nothing when he is knocked up and focused.
edits.after: First item you stack armour — Frozen Heart or Sunfire plus your E slow out-trades most AD, but Olaf is the exception you cannot fully solve. Reckless Swing is flat true damage that ignores armour and Granite Shield alike, and Ragnarok's passive armour and MR mean your damage falls off while his does not. A fed Olaf still wins the straight 1v1. Do not split-duel him. Flank his carries with R in teamfights, where his duelling lifesteal means nothing.

edits.before: Unstoppable Force is your one clean window — R knock-up answers his Ragnarok all-in and lets you flip a fight or roam.
edits.after: Unstoppable Force is your one clean window — but land it BEFORE he presses Ragnarok, because an active R ignores your knock-up.

edits.before: Ragnarok's true damage ignores your armor and Granite Shield, so a fed Olaf 1v1 still reclaims this lane — fight him only with your team.
edits.after: Reckless Swing's true damage ignores your armour and Granite Shield, and Ragnarok hands him free resistances — fight him only with your team.

edits.after: Unstoppable Force is your biggest spike, but Ragnarok is CC immunity — knock him up before he presses it, never after.

notes: Two hard errors here, both of which would get a player killed. First, four separate strings told them Unstoppable Force interrupts a Ragnarok all-in; Ragnarok is immunity to disables and the full layer's own dontsFull already said so, so the page contradicted itself. Second, the true damage was pinned on Ragnarok when it belongs to Reckless Swing (E, 11/10/9/8/7, 325 range) — and the full-layer tldr called it percent health, which Riot's text does not support at all. Best new interaction: Undertow reduces armour, and Ground Slam's damage scales off Malphite's armour, so his axe is a damage debuff on your E and not merely a slow. Chart: content.win has level 1 as a coinflip and level 6 as nobody's, against its own 'Olaf owns the opener' and 'Level 6 is your moment'; target is Olaf, Olaf, Olaf, Skill, Malphite, Skill, Olaf. One flag I ignored: Olaf's kit marks Undertow as grounding, which Riot's description does not mention, so no dash-denial claim was written.
